rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-ole-miss-oklah.blurb: No. 19 Ole Miss is a 1.5-point favorite in Norman, roughly a 57% play by ESPN's numbers against an unranked but dangerous Oklahoma side. Total of 49.5 suggests neither defense is expected to fully lock things down.

predictions:ucla.blurb: UCLA climbed to No. 4 from No. 8, and while SP+ is on board at 11th, FPI is a tougher sell at 27th.

games:2026-wk11-florida-kentucky.blurb: No. 11 Kentucky is only a 3.5-point home favorite against unranked Florida, with ESPN's model splitting it nearly down the middle at 53.8%. A total of 52.5 suggests points are available, and anything but a Wildcats win would be a serious blow to their standing.

games:2026-wk11-texas-lsu.blurb: No. 21 LSU gets No. 6 Texas in Baton Rouge and is laying four, with ESPN giving the Tigers a slim 52.6% edge. The 46.5 total points to a grinder, and the loser's margin for error in the SEC gets awfully thin.

games:2026-wk11-utah-arizona.blurb: No. 2 Utah heads to No. 23 Arizona as just a 2.5-point favorite, the kind of line that says this is a live underdog spot. ESPN still likes the Utes at 60.4%, but a slip here would shake up the Big 12 race at the top.

games:2026-wk11-usc-indiana.blurb: No. 9 Indiana hosts No. 18 USC as a 7.5-point favorite with ESPN pegging the Hoosiers at 78.2%. Indiana is chasing in the Big Ten and can't afford to trade a home win for a résumé dent.

games:2026-wk11-texas-tech-oklahoma-stat.blurb: No. 12 Texas Tech is a 3.5-point underdog at No. 25 Oklahoma State in a game with a 72.5 total -- bring a calculator. It's essentially a coin flip by ESPN's numbers (51.6% Cowboys), and the Red Raiders' bubble position hangs on it.

games:2026-wk11-missouri-georgia.blurb: No. 1 Georgia is a 15.5-point favorite over No. 22 Missouri at home, with ESPN giving the Bulldogs an 88.8% shot. For Missouri, a cover-plus-upset would be the biggest résumé swing available this week.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-illinois-ucla.blurb: No. 4 UCLA lays 10 at home to Illinois with a modest 47.5 total, and ESPN makes the Bruins a 73.8% pick. As the Big Ten's current leader, UCLA's job is simply to keep handling business.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-michigan-orego.blurb: No. 16 Oregon is a 10.5-point home favorite over Michigan in a game with a 38.5 total, the lowest number on the board. ESPN gives the Ducks an 85.8% chance as they try to keep climbing after a jump in the rankings.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-south-carolina.blurb: No. 17 South Carolina goes to Arkansas as a 7.5-point road favorite, with ESPN at 77.3% for the Gamecocks. A road win keeps them firmly in the ranked conversation; a stumble undoes it fast.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-wake-forest-sm.blurb: No. 13 Wake Forest is a 1.5-point underdog at SMU even though ESPN's model actually favors the Demon Deacons at 59.1%. With a 61.5 total and Wake's ACC and bubble hopes on the line, this is the week's quietest high-stakes game.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-northwestern-o.blurb: No. 20 Ohio State hosts Northwestern as a 12.5-point favorite at an 85.4% clip per ESPN. After sliding in the rankings, the Buckeyes need the kind of comfortable win that gets voters' attention back.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-houston-colora.blurb: No. 14 Houston is a 9.5-point favorite at Colorado with ESPN giving the Cougars an 83% shot. Houston sits just outside the field, so style points on the road are worth collecting.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-baylor-byu.blurb: No. 10 BYU welcomes Baylor as a 7.5-point favorite and a 68.5% pick by ESPN's model. The Cougars are chasing Utah in the Big 12 and can't give anything back.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-purdue-iowa.blurb: No. 15 Iowa is a 17.5-point home favorite over Purdue, the biggest spread involving a ranked team outside South Bend, with ESPN at 87.1%. Iowa is on the bubble and needs the convincing version of this win.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-duke-miami.blurb: No. 7 Miami hosts Duke favored by 13.5 with an 88% win probability from ESPN. As the ACC's current leader, the Hurricanes' path is about avoiding the banana peel.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-alabama-vander.blurb: No. 3 Alabama is a 16.5-point favorite at Vanderbilt and a 94.8% pick by ESPN's model. The Tide are chasing Georgia in the SEC, so the margin matters as much as the result.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-tennessee-texa.blurb: No. 8 Tennessee is only a 2.5-point favorite at Texas A&M in a game with a 43.5 total, and ESPN gives the Vols just a 58.6% edge. A road loss to an unranked opponent would sting badly in the top-10 picture.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-boston-college.blurb: No. 5 Notre Dame is favored by 29.5 over Boston College, with ESPN putting the Irish at 98.5% -- as close to a formality as the slate offers. The only real question is how long the starters stay on the field.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-oregon-state-b.blurb: No. 24 Boise State hosts Oregon State as a 13.5-point favorite with a 65.5 total and an 81.7% ESPN win probability. For a team clinging to the back of the rankings, anything close would be a problem.

predictions:kentucky.blurb: Kentucky tumbled from No. 6 to No. 11, and the analytics are even harsher: SP+ has the Wildcats 41st and FPI 35th, both far below their poll slot.

predictions:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State slid from 12th to 20th in the poll, but the models still love the Buckeyes -- third in SP+ and fifth in FPI, the widest gap in their favor on the board.

predictions:ole-miss.blurb: Ole Miss dropped nine spots to No. 19, and the metrics aren't rushing to defend them: 30th in SP+, 12th in FPI.

predictions:oregon.blurb: Oregon jumped from 23rd to 16th, and the numbers suggest the climb isn't finished -- SP+ has the Ducks 15th and FPI ninth.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: The SEC's auto bid is the tightest race in the sport: No. 1 Georgia leads with No. 3 Alabama just two spots back and breathing on them.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-ten.blurb: No. 4 UCLA holds the Big Ten's automatic bid, with No. 9 Indiana five spots behind and very much in range.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-acc.blurb: No. 7 Miami owns the ACC's auto bid, but No. 13 Wake Forest is six spots back and closing in on the league's lone guaranteed spot.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: No. 2 Utah has built the widest cushion of any league leader in the Big 12, eight spots clear of No. 10 BYU.

bubbleNotes:texas-tech.blurb: Texas Tech is the first team out at the 13 seed, one spot from the field after climbing three places. Next up: No. 25 Oklahoma State, exactly the kind of ranked opponent that can finish the job.

bubbleNotes:iowa.blurb: Iowa sits last among the bubble four at the 16 seed, four spots from the field, though a four-place jump says the arrow is pointing up.

bubbleNotes:houston.blurb: Houston moved up three to the 15 seed and is three spots from the field -- trending the right way, but still needing help.

bubbleNotes:wake-forest.blurb: Wake Forest climbed three spots to the 14 seed and now sits just two away from the field, with the ACC auto bid still theoretically in play.
